typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	FileName as string (),
	OLEDBDestination1_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		power as string,
		{date time} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FlatFileSource1
FlatFileSource1 derive(Fname1 = $FileName) ~> DerivedColumn1
FlatFileSource1 aggregate(groupBy(),
	rowcount = count(1)) ~> RowCount10
DerivedColumn1 sink(input(
		Fname as string,
		Power as double,
		Date as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy'
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		Fname = Fname1,
		Power = power,
		Date = {date time}),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination1_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination1
RowCount10 sink(validateSchema: false,
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	store: 'cache',
	format: 'inline',
	output: true,
	saveOrder: 1) ~> RowCount1CACHESINK
